title: Shopify Exchange screenshot service crossed internal boundaries
summary: Shopify confirms a USD 25,000 award for a screenshot-service isolation flaw.
root_cause: Server-initiated requests could reach internal infrastructure and metadata that should have been isolated.
impact: Root access was possible within one infrastructure subset. Shopify explicitly says its core platform was outside that subset.
defensive_takeaways: Restrict service egress and protect infrastructure metadata.
Preserve strong isolation between infrastructure groups.

reward.evidence_quote: SSRF in Exchange leads to ROOT access in all instances - Bounty: $25,000
reward.evidence_location: Top Three Interesting Bugs, first entry
reward.notes: Vendor retrospective explicitly ties this amount to one report. Original report, award, and fix dates are not supplied.
